scope: B03 real profile/password/navbar integration on _test; future workflows pending
results: Profile/Settings real routes are protected and own data is scoped
Student/BM names persist after reload and relogin
Display name follows DB public reporter projection without leaking identifiers
Name validation handles UTF-8 boundaries and rejects invalid fields atomically
Readonly identity/role and foreign account targets cannot be mutated
Guest/invalid CSRF/foreign origin account writes leave data unchanged
Password validation rejects incorrect old, mismatch, unchanged and unsafe lengths
Password change rotates current session/CSRF, revokes other sessions, and changes login
BM can change own password without gaining Student-only actions
Maximum bcrypt byte boundary works and suffix/overlong UTF-8 is rejected
Failed current-password attempts are limited across sessions and refresh
Two concurrent password changes produce one winner, not two overwrites
Expired session cannot submit a profile/password mutation
Profile UI readonly fields and private Student identifier differ correctly by role
Profile save updates summary/navbar, reload and relogin
Client validation and reset keep a meaningful draft and keyboard focus
Failed save keeps draft/retry state, and busy controls prevent duplicate requests
Password UI success clears inputs, keeps current login, revokes peer and permits logout
Password client mismatch/byte errors are inline and secrets stay out of localStorage
Expired browser form redirects to login with a safe return instead of replaying POST
DB display-name HTML is escaped in summary/menu/input
Own unread count is real and does not include another account notifications
Both roles use top-nav/account menu with active page, keyboard/Escape/outside close
Profile/Settings and nav are usable for both roles at all five required viewports
